name: wheel-rail rigid contact
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 将轮轨接触处几何关系按刚性接触约束处理的假设。
usage_overview: 用于车辆—轨道及列车—轨道—桥梁动力模型的接触简化：在轮轨保持接触时忽略法向弹性压缩，通过几何协调约束连接车辆与钢轨的运动，并据此耦合系统方程。

complete_examples.text: For example, with wheel-rail rigid contact assumption, no presentations of computer program have been provided to consider vehicle/track sepa-rations in three-dimensional (3D) space until now.

Railway engineering Vehicle-track interactions Versatile track model Finite element method Wheel-rail contacts A B S T R A C T Take hypothesis of wheel-rail rigid contact, this work presents a new method to characterize the vehicle-track interaction in the three-dimensional (3-D) space.
In this paper, a coupled approach to construct the vehicle-track interaction model is specifically proposed by further improving the models built upon the hypothesis of wheel-rail rigid contact.

From the above comparison, it is known that the wheel-rail rigid contact model (contact model-II) shows approach precision to wheel-rail elastic contact model (contact model-I) below the frequency of 350 Hz and shows relatively larger values at frequencies above it.

In general the wheel-rail rigid contact model shows higher efficiency and time-domain integration stability but its precision can be mainly guaranteed at frequencies below 350 Hz, if higher than that, it produces larger system responses comparing to wheel-rail elastic contact model.
